Frozen legacy turn counter breaks card expiry + turn records; no-turn-limit ruling applied (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 1)
Dead endTurn() still holds the missing-DOB end-game penalty (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 2) — ported penalty logic into live endTurnWithMovement path, deleted dead endTurn

Two disagreeing duration-card lifecycles (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 3) — playCard now delegates to finalizePlayedCard (duration_count) instead of parsing the word column; also fixed a stale endTurn mock in PlayerActionService.test.ts caught by a full-suite run

Replaced cards leak out of the game (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 4) — replaceCard now uses discardCards instead of the leaky removeCard, so old cards wait in the discard pile per maintainer ruling
5% investment fee silently skipped when unaffordable (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 5) — added allowNegative to recordCost + shared bankruptcy passthrough via EffectEngineService
Duplicate shortId after removing a player during setup (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 6) — generateShortPlayerId now finds the lowest unused Pn instead of deriving from players.length
Color/avatar conflict resolver can hand two players the same replacement (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 7) — reassigned values now enter the used-set immediately
canEndTurn movement-intent guard is a no-op (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 8) — fixed player.moveIntent !== undefined to a truthy check since the cleared sentinel is null, not undefined

Timed life events tick per-holder-turn (2026-07-11 blind code review, item 9) + Dice/seed-money dedup (item 10) + a real pre-existing TEMP/REAL staleness bug surfaced and fixed (realStates cache not synced by updateTempState's fallback path) — this closes all 10 items from the 2026-07-11 blind code review batch

Push-back/Lock-the-scope cost preview (feature request, spec locked 2026-07-12) — built shared cost-classification layer (costPreview.ts) + tap-based TurnCostToggle in PlayerPanelV2 footer; first pass wrongly targeted classic ActionCenterPanel with hover popovers, reverted and rebuilt after maintainer correction (hover doesn't work on phones; classic panel is being phased out)

Join-by-Code player picker — GET /api/games/:gameId/join-info now returns a minimal player roster; PlayerSetup.tsx's Join-by-Code flow shows a 'which player are you?' picker instead of always dropping rejoiners into spectator view; user redirected this pick mid-session after asking to read new dashboard reports first, which surfaced these two as directly relevant

Join-by-Code picker takeover warning (user-requested follow-up to v3.0.122) — threaded playerId through the WS connect chain so server presence tracking actually works, added getConnectedPlayerIds + connected roster field, picker now confirms before letting someone take over an actively-connected player's seat

Owner alert email moved from CREATE_GAME (site visit) to GAME_STARTED (real game start) — also fixed a dead 'PLAYING' vs 'PLAY' gamePhase typo that meant GAME_STARTED detection had never fired; alert now includes player names

Deploy countdown banner — server.js shutdown() now broadcasts server_shutdown_notice to all active game rooms before restarting, with per-room game code; ShutdownNotice component shows dismissible banner in GameLayout+TVDisplay; safe now that join-by-code picker (v3.0.122/123) makes rejoin unambiguous

Cost-preview toggle stale Varies fix — getEndTurnCostPreview now skips already-completed manual/dice effects via new shared isManualEffectCompleted() helper (also de-duplicated matching logic out of PlayerPanelV2.tsx); getTryAgainCostPreview deliberately unchanged since Try Again rolls back regardless of completion. Implementing agent hit an API session limit mid-verification; orchestrator reviewed the completed diff, ran typecheck/build/tests (550 passing) and landed it.

CharacterBadge/NarrativeBlock hardcoded light-mode colors showed as a stray light box in DiceResultModal dark mode — added optional mode prop (default light, so ChoiceModal/CardModal unaffected), DiceResultModal now passes mode={shellMode}

Plain npm test hang root-caused: not a deadlock — the 4 tests/ghost regression gates (50 full-game sims each, 20-30min calibrated timeouts) were silently included in the fast dev config; excluded them there, added dedicated vitest.config.ghost.ts + npm run test:ghost (separate config because npm run shells via cmd.exe on Windows, killing inline env-var toggles), updated TESTING_GUIDE + CLAUDE.md; npm test now completes in ~99s (2354/2355)

ChoiceModal dark-mode coverage slice 1 — mirrors DiceResultModal pattern (getStoredPanelMode + panelPalettes), threads mode into ModalBase/CharacterBadge/NarrativeBlock, buttons use panelPalettes accent instead of hardcoded colors.primary. Board/TVDisplay/CardReplacementModal deferred to future slices.
